senses.gloss:
कुट् कुट्, cl. 6. P. कुटति, चुकोट, कुटि-
ष्यति, अकुटीत्, कुटितुम्, to be or become
crooked or curved; to bend, curve, curl; to make
crooked; to be dishonest, cheat or deceive; cl. 4. P.
कुट्यति, or cl. 10. A. कोटयते, -यितुम्, to break
to pieces, tear asunder, divide; to speak indistinctly;
to be warm, burn: Caus. कोटयति: Desid. चुकुटि-
षति: Intens. चोकुट्यते; [cf. कुट्ट् and कुण्ट्.]

कूट् कूट्, cl. 10. P. कूटयति, to burn; to
give pain, be distressed, to call, invite; to
counsel, advise; A. कूटयते, to avoid or decline
giving, not to give; to render indistinct or unin-
telligible, to muddle, to render confused or foul; to
be distressed; to despair; [cf. Eng. heat, hot; Old
Island. hiti, heitr; Germ. hitze, heiss.]

कुट, अस् or अम्, m. n. a water-pot, a jar, pitcher;
(अस्), m. a fort, a stronghold; a house [cf. कुटि,
कुटी, and कूट]; a hammer, a mallet for breaking
small stones; a tree; a mountain; N. of a man;
(अम्), n., Ved. = कृत, a work.
—कुट-कारिका, f.
a female servant (bringing the water-jar).
—कुट-ज,
अस्, m. the medicinal tree Wrightia Antidysenterica,
commonly called Karaya; the seeds are used as a
vermifuge [cf. इन्द्र-यव]; a N. of the sage
Agastya (‘born in a water-jar’); also of Droṇa,
q. v.
—कुटज-मल्ली, f. a kind of plant.

कुट्ट, अस्, ई, अम्, (at the end of compounds) cut-
ting, dividing, making small; grinding, pounding;
(अस्), m. a multiplier such that a given dividend being
multiplied by it and a given quantity added to (or
subtracted from) the product, the sum (or difference)
may be measured by a given divisor.
—कुट्टप-
रान्त or कुट्टापरान्त (˚ट-अप्˚), आस्, m. pl., N.
of a people.
—कुट्ट-प्रचरण and कुट्ट-प्रा-
वरण, आस्, m. pl., N. of two nations.

कूट कूट, अस्, अम्, m. n. the bone of the
forehead with its projections or prominences, a horn;
the crown of the head; any prominence or projec-
tion (e. g. अंस-कूट, the hump of a buffalo; अक्षि-
कूट, the prominence of the forehead above the eye);
summit, the peak or summit of a mountain; summit,
head, i. e. the highest, the most excellent, the first;
a heap, a multitude (e. g. अभ्र-कूट, a multitude of
clouds); a kind of vessel or implement; a hammer,
an iron mallet; part of a plough, a ploughshare, the
body of a plough; a trap for catching deer; a con-
cealed weapon as a dagger in a wooden case, a sword-
stick &c.; illusion, fraud, trick, deceit; a roguish
scheme or plot; a knotty point, a puzzling question,
an enigma, an obscure passage; untruth, falsehood,
(or attributively) false, untrue; vile, low; uniform
substance (as the ethereal element &c.); a water-
jar; a kind of plant; (अस्, ई), m. f. a house, a
dwelling [cf. कुट and कुटी]; (अस्), m. an epithet of
Agastya; (अस्, आ, अम्), Ved. not horned or cornuted,
as an animal with incomplete continuations of the
bone of the forehead; (अस्), m. an ox whose horns
are broken.
—कूट-कार, अस्, m. a rogue, a cheat, a
false witness.
—कूट-कारक, अस्, इका, अम्, a rogue,
a cheat, a false witness.
—कूट-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, cheating,
committing a fraud, bribing; (त्), m. a Kāyastha or
man of the writer-caste; an epithet of Śiva.
—कूट-
खड्ग, अस्, m. a hidden sword, a sword-stick.
—कूट-ग्रन्थ, title of a work supposed to be
written by Vyāsa.
—कूट-च्छद्मन्, आ, m. a rogue,
a cheat.
—कूट-ता, f. or कूट-त्व, अम्, n. falsehood,
fraud.
—कूट-तूला, f. a false pair of scales.
—कूट-
धर्म, अस्, आ, अम्, (a country or house) where
falsehood is considered a duty.
—कूट-पर्व or
कूट-पूर्व, अस्, m. fever occurring in an elephant
from vitiation of the three humors; (more correctly
कूट-पूर्व.)
—कूट-पालक, अस्, m. a bilious fever;
a potter's kiln.
—कूट-पाश, अस्, m. a trap.
—कूट-
बन्ध, अस्, m. a trap.
—कूट-मान, अम्, n. a
false measure or weight.
—कूट-मुद्गर, अस्, m.
a concealed weapon similar to a hammer.
—कूट-
मोहन, अस्, m. an epithet of Skanda.
—कूट-
यन्त्र, अम्, n. a trap or snare for deer, birds, &c.
—कूट-युद्ध, अम्, n. a treacherous or unfair
battle; (अस्, आ, अम्), fighting treacherously.
—कूट-
योधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fighting unfairly or treacherously.
—कूट-रचना, f. a laid trap.
—कूट-शस्, ind. in
heaps, in multitudes, by crowds.
—कूट-शाल्मलि, इस्,
m. f. or इका, f. a fabulous cotton-plant with sharp
thorns, with which the wicked are tortured in the
world of Yama; a species of the Simul silk-cotton
tree.
—कूट-शासन, अम्, n. a forged or false grant
or decree.
—कूट-शैल, अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
—कूट-साक्षिन्, ई, m. a false witness.
—कूट-स्थ,
अस्, आ, अम्, standing at the top, keeping the highest
position; standing in a multitude, standing in the
midst; (in phil.) immovable, uniform, unchangeable,
perpetually and universally the same, as the soul,
[]
spirit, space, ether, sound, &c.; (अम्), n. a sort of
perfume, a species of dried shell-fish, commonly
Nakhi; the soul.
—कूटस्थ-ता, f. or कूटस्थ-
त्व, अम्, n. unchangeableness, uniformity.
—कूट-
स्वर्ण, अम्, n. alloyed or counterfeit gold.
—कूटा-
क्ष (˚ट-अक्˚), अस्, m. loaded or false dice.
—कूटा-
गार (˚ट-आग्˚), अम्, n. an upper room, an apartment
on the top of a house.
—कूटार्थ (˚ट-अर्˚), अस्,
m. ambiguity of meaning, fiction.
—कूटार्थ-भा-
षिता, f., scil. कथा, a tale, a story, a fiction.
—कू-
टोपाय (˚ट-उप्˚), अस्, m. trick, fraud, stratagem.

कुटक, अस्, m., N. of a people; N. of a moun-
tain; the post round which the string of the churning-
stick winds [cf. कुटर and कुठर]; (अम्), n. a
plough without a pole.

कुट्टक, अस्, आ, अम्, what cuts or divides, what
pounds or grinds; (अस्), m. a grinder or pulverizer, a
multiplier, &c. [cf. कुट्ट]; a kingfisher.
—कुट्टक-
व्यवहार, अस्, m. or कुट्टकाध्याय (˚क-अध्˚),
अस्, m. that branch or chapter of arithmetic which
treats of the कुट्ट or कुट्टक.
कुट्टाक, अस्, ई, अम्, what cuts or divides.

कूटक, अम्, n. elevation, prominence, projection;
the body of a plough (i. e. the wood without the
ploughshare and pole); a ploughshare; illusion, fraud,
untruth, deceit; (अस्, आ, अम्), fraudulent, unfair; (अस्),
m., N. of a mountain; a braid or tress of hair; a
perfume; see मुरा.
—कूटकाख्यान (˚क-आख्˚),
अम्, n. an invented tale.

कुटि, इस्, ई, m. f. a curvature, a curve; a hut,
cottage, house, hall, shop; (ई), f. a vessel with
openings used for fumigations; a bawd, a procuress
or go-between; a nosegay, a bundle or tuft of flowers
or vegetables; a kind of perfume, commonly Murā;
spirituous liquor; (इस्), m. the body; a tree; [cf.
Eng. hut; Germ. Hütte.]
—कुटि-चर, अस्, m. a
crocodile or porpoise.
—कुटि-पार्थिव, अस्, m., N.
of a man.
—कुटी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, curved, curled,
twisted, frizzled; (अम्), n. anything (as woollen cloth)
curled or twisted.
—कुटी-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, inside the
house.
—कुटी-गु, उस्, m., N. of a man.
—कुटी-
चक, अस्, m. a kind of religious mendicant, one
[]
who lives at his son's expense; (lit. ‘delighting in
staying in the house.’)
—कुटी-चर, अस्, m. an
ascetic of a particular order, one who consigns the
care of his family to his son and remains at home en-
gaged solely in devotion; or one who goes begging
from one house to another.
—कुटी-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
consisting of a house (?).
—कुटी-मुख, अस्, m., N.
of one of the attendants of Kuvera.
कुटि कुटि, कुटिर. See under rt. कुट् above.

कुटिक, अस्, आ, अम्, bent, crooked; (आ), f., N. of
a river.
कुटीका, f. a small house.
कुटित, अस्, आ, अम्, crooked, bent.

कुट्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, divided; pounded, flat-
tened; (आ), f., scil. सिरा, unskilful opening of a vein,
the latter being cut to pieces by repeated application
of the knife.

कुटितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, making crooked; acting
dishonestly; being bent.
कुटिर, अम्, n. a hut, a cottage.
कुटीर कुटीर. See under rt. कुट्, col. 2.

कुट्टीर कुट्टीर, अस्, m. a mountain; [cf.
कुटीर and कुट्टार.]

कुटिल, अस्, आ, अम्, bent, crooked, curved, round,
running in curved lines, crisped, curled; going
crookedly, tortuous; insincere, dishonest, fraudu-
lent; (आ), f., N. of a plant [cf. तगरपादी]; N. of
a river; (according to some) N. of the Sarasvatī;
N. of a metre containing four lines of fourteen sylla-
bles each; (अम्), n., N. of a plant [cf. तगर,
कुञ्चित, वक्र]; a kind of perfume; tin.
—कुटिल-
गति, इस्, f. a species of the Atijagatī metre, = चन्-
द्रिका.
—कुटिल-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going crookedly,
tortuous.
—कुटिल-ता, f. or कुटिल-त्व, अम्, n.
crookedness; guile, dishonesty.
—कुटिल-पक्ष्म,
अस्, आ, अम्, having curved eyelashes or brows.
—कुटिल-स्वभाव, अस्, आ, अम्, crooked-minded,
disingenuous.
—कुटिलाशय (˚ल-आश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
ill-intentioned, malevolent.
कुटिल कुटिल. See under rt. कुट्, col. 2.

कुटिलक, अस्, इका, अम्, bent, curved, crooked,
winding; (इका), f. crouching, coming stealthily as a
hunter on his prey; a peculiar movement or gesture
(in theatrical language); an instrument used by a
blacksmith, a blacksmith's forge.

कुटीय, nom. P. कुटीयति, -यितुम्, to imagine
one's self in a hut.
कुटीरक, अस्, m. a hut.

कुट्टीरक कुट्टीरक, अम्, n. (?) a small house,
a hut; (a wrong reading for कुटीरक?).

कुटङ्क कुटङ्क, अस्, m. (connected with
कुट above), a roof, a thatch; [cf. कुटुङ्गक,
कुडङ्ग, कुण्डङ्ग, कुटल.]
कुटङ्ग कुटङ्ग, N. of a place.

कुटङ्गक कुटङ्गक, अस्, m. an arbour formed
by creeping plants overrunning a tree; a roof or
thatch; a house, a small house, a hut or cottage;
[cf. कुटुङ्गक.]

कुटच कुटच, अस्, m. (for कुट-ज), the
medicinal tree Wrightia Antidysenterica.
कुटज कुट-ज. See under कुट above.

कूटज कूटज, अस्, m. the plant Wrightia
Antidysenterica; [cf. कुटज.]

कुटन्नक कुटन्नक, अम्, n. the fragrant
grass Cyperus Rotundus; [cf. also the following.]

कुटन्नट कुटन्नट, अस्, m. the tree Calos-
anthes Indica; (अम्), n. the fragrant grass Cyperus
Rotundus.

कुटप कुटप, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कुट्),
a measure of grain &c. (= कुडव); a saint, a
divine sage or Muni; a garden or grove near a house
(= निष्कुट); (अम्), n. a lotus.

कुटर कुटर, अस्, m. a post round which
the string passes that works the churning-stick [cf.
कुटक and कुठर]; N. of a Nāga.

कुट्टार कुट्टार, अस्, m. a mountain; (अम्),
n. sexual intercourse; pleasure; a woollen cloth or
blanket; exclusion; oneness; [cf. कुटीर and कुट्-
टीर.]

कुटरु कुटरु, उस्, m., Ved. a cock; a tent,
a house of cloth or canvas.

कुटरुणा कुटरुणा, f. a plant, commonly
Teöri, Ipomœa Turpethum.

कुटल कुटल, अम्, n. a roof, a thatch; [cf.
कुटङ्क.]
कुटिकोष्टिका कुटिकोष्टिका, f., N. of a river.

कुटुङ्गक कुटुङ्गक, अस्, m. an arbour or
bower formed of creeping plants; a creeper winding
round a tree; a thatch, a roof; a hut, a cottage; a
granary, a store-room; [cf. कुटङ्क, कुटङ्गक,
कुडङ्ग.]

कुटुनी कुटुनी, f. a wrong reading for
कुट्टनी, q. v.

कुटुम्ब कुटुम्ब, अम्, n. a household, the
collective members of a household, a family; the care
of a family, house-keeping; the care taken by a
householder for the members of his family, hence
metaphorically care or anxiety about anything; (अस्,
अम्), m. n. name; race; a kinsman, a relation by
descent; a connection, a relation by marriage by the
mother's side; offspring, progeny.
—कुटुम्ब-क-
लह, अस्, अम्, m. n. domestic dissension, family
feud.
—कुटुम्ब-व्यापृत, अस्, m. a provident and
attentive father of a family.
—कुटुम्बार्थम् (˚ब-
अर्˚), ind. for the support or on account of a family.
—कुटुम्बौकस् (˚ब-ओक्˚), अस्, n. apartments &c.
appropriated to the accommodation of relations &c.
कुटुम्बय, nom. A. -यते, to support a family.

कुटुम्बिक, अस्, आ, अम्, taking care of a family or
household; (अस्), m. the slave of a house.

कुटुम्बिन्, ई, m. a householder, a paterfamilias;
one who supports or takes care of a family; meta-
phorically one who takes care of anything (especially
at the end of a compound); a member of a family,
any one belonging to a household; a peasant, a
cultivator of the soil; (इनी), f. the wife of a house-
holder and mother of a family, a matron; a large
household, a large family; a small shrub used in
medicine, a kind of moon-plant, = क्षीरिणी.
—कु-
टुम्बि-ता, f. or कुटुम्बि-त्व, अम्, n. family con-
nection or union, living as one family.

कुटेर कुटेर, अस्, m. a hut, a cottage; [cf.
कुटीर.]

कुट्टन, अम्, n. cutting, dividing; pounding,
grinding, beating, threshing; abusing; (ई), f. a bawd,
a procuress, a go-between.
कुट्टन्ती, f. a kind of dagger.

कुट्टिन्, ई, इनी, इ, what cuts or pounds; (नी), f. a
bawd, a procuress.

कुट्टिम, अस्, आ, अम्, plastered with small stones,
decorated with mosaic; (अस्, अम्), m. n. an inlaid or
paved floor, pavement, ground paved with mosaic or
[]
small stones, ground smoothed and plastered; ground
prepared for the site of a mansion; a jewel mine; a
hut, a cottage; the pomegranate.

कुट्टमित कुट्टमित, अम्, n. one of the ten
blandishments of women, affected repulse of a lover's
caresses; [cf. कुट्टुमित.]

कुट्टिहारिका कुट्टिहारिका, f. a female servant,
a slave; [cf. कुट-हारिका.]
कुट्टुमित कुट्टुमित, अम्, n. = कुट्टमित above.

कुट्मल कुट्मल, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr.
rt. कुट्), opening or expanding as the blossom of a
flower, blossoming; (अस्, अम्), m. n. an opening
bud; (अम्), n. one of the twenty-one hells in which
sinners are punished (where they are bound with
ropes).
कुट्मलित, अस्, आ, अम्, budded.
